skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deal 90% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deal 70% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 30% chance to inflict [Collapse] on the main target for 1 turn (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deal 70% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 30% chance to inflict [Collapse] on the main target for 1 turn (DMG reduction rate lowered by 40%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. After being hit, has a 20% chance to increase own DMG dealt by 10% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. After being hit, has a 20% chance to increase own DMG dealt by 20% for 1 turn.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. After being hit, has a 20% chance to increase own DMG dealt by 25% for 1 turn.
